{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Birds}} {{Otheruses|the monster|other uses|Duck (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = Male |version2 = Female |name = Duck |image1 = [[File:Duck.png|280px]] |image2 = [[File:Duck (female).png|280px]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |members = No |combat = 1 |size = 1 |examine1 = Quackers. |examine2 = She quackers. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 0 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 25 |slayxp = 3 |cat = Birds |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 3 |att = 1 |str = 1 |def = 1 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = -47 |strbns = -42 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = -42 |dslash = -42 |dcrush = -42 |dmagic = -42 |dlight = -42 |dstandard = -42 |dheavy = -42 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 1838 |id2 = 1839 }} '''Ducks''' are small animals that can be found in rivers or lakes. They are a fairly good way to start training the [[Magic]] [[Skills|skill]] with low-level [[Curse]] spells and even [[Strike spells]]. If ducks are next to the shore, it is possible to hit them with a long-range [[melee]] [[Weapons|weapon]] such as a [[halberd]]; however, it is uncommon for them to be there with the exception of the [[Fishing Guild]] docks, [[Falador Park]], and the [[River Lum]] in [[Lumbridge]]. For melee it is possible to use a halberd, even though [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] is most reliable. [[Ammunition]] will be '''lost''' if the ducks are not on land. It is possible to use non long-range melee on the ducks at the Fishing Guild's docks. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Duck |location = Along the [[River Lum]] south of [[Varrock]] present |} ==Trivia== * The colours of ducks are similar to those found on real-life {{Wp|mallard}}s. * Singular [[duckling]]s or a group of [[ducklings]] will only follow female ducks. Occasionally, the female duck will say: {{overhead|Quack?}}, to which any following ducklings respond with: {{overhead|Eep!}}. If the female duck they're following is killed, the ducklings will say: {{overhead|Cheep cheep!}}, followed by: {{overhead|Eep!}} and attempt to swim away. * During the [[2021 Christmas event]], variant [[Duck (2021 Christmas event)|ducks]] and [[Drake (2021 Christmas event)|drakes]] were used in [[Falador]]. These variants wore [[Santa hat]]s, walked around the frozen [[White Knights' Castle]] moat and [[Falador Park]] puddles, and were unattackable. One female duck in the park was also replaced during this time. {{South Falador Farm}} [[Category:Monsters that retreat when low hitpoints]]
